card.name: Start of photodynamic and photo- words
card.fires_on: The opening piece of words like photodynamic, photoactivation, phototoxic and photodermatoses in light-activated drug labels. Also fires weakly on a few other places, such as stent-related words.

modes.label: Photo- word starts
